title: Angel/Devil Mortal
description: Sign up for a one-to-one Angel/Devil and Mortal event. Your numeric Telegram user ID lets the relay bots identify you without a registration code.

sections.title: Devil and Mortal
sections.description: Devils provide welfare and may also plan pranks. Follow the event rules and the mortal's stated boundaries.

sections.title: Declaration
sections.description: Read the event rules and help keep the event safe and enjoyable for everyone.

sections.title: Telegram Channel!
sections.description: Ask the organiser for the event announcement-channel link.

questions.title: What’s your tele Telegram user id?
questions.description: Enter the numeric ID shown by @userinfobot, not your @handle.

validation.error: Please enter your numeric Telegram user ID, not your handle.

questions.title: Do you have any special requirements? (e.g. allergies, etc.)
Angel and Mortal (welfare only) or Devil and Mortal (welfare and pranks)?
questions.description: You can set prank boundaries and a tolerance level if you choose Devil.

questions.title: Level of Prank Tolerance
questions.description:
1 - limited to easily reversible pranks (posters/sticky notes/extra chalk on your door)
2 - slightly further, okay with pranks that slightly affect the general area (double sided tape on slippers, slime on door handle)
3 - the midpoint, pranks may somewhat hinder day to day activities (relocating footwear, moderately obstructing room entrance)
4 - more extreme, pranks could take quite some time to remedy (rearranging the room in an inconvenient manner)
5 - all hell breaks loose, everything not covered in the rules is free game (good luck)

questions.title: Are you okay with your devil entering your room?
questions.description: (you may specify and set boundaries of what they can/cannot do if you choose to allow this)

questions.title: Please specify any boundaries/things that are off limits for your devil [Tick to indicate OFF LIMIT]
questions.description: This includes what you do NOT want touched, information you do not want on posters, and how far your room may be changed. Be as specific as possible!

questions.title: I have looked through and understood the rules of this event and agree to respect the boundaries set by my mortal.
questions.description: For questions, contact the event organisers.
